parameters.jsCode: const raw=$input.first().json;const x=raw.body||raw;const decision=String(x.decision||'').toUpperCase();const core=['episode_id','review_id','asset_id','asset_version','decision_modified_at','stage_run_key'];const missing=core.filter(k=>x[k]===undefined||x[k]===null||x[k]==='');if(!['APPROVED','CHANGES_REQUESTED','REJECTED'].includes(decision))missing.push('decision');if(['CHANGES_REQUESTED','REJECTED'].includes(decision)&&!String(x.feedback||'').trim())missing.push('feedback');if(decision==='CHANGES_REQUESTED'&&!String(x.change_scope||'').trim())missing.push('change_scope');const rawThreshold=x.context_risk_review_threshold;const threshold=rawThreshold!==undefined&&rawThreshold!==null&&String(rawThreshold).trim()!==''?Number(rawThreshold):NaN;return [{json:{...x,decision,test_mode:x.test_mode!==false,allow_external_writes:x.allow_external_writes===true,allow_delivery:x.allow_delivery===true,allow_error_writes:x.allow_error_writes===true,context_risk_review_threshold:Number.isFinite(threshold)?threshold:null,atomic_claim_verified:false,atomic_claim_block_reason:'TST-AIRTABLE-01 requires uniquely enforced conditional ownership',contract_valid:missing.length===0,missing_fields:[...new Set(missing)],stage_name:'review_decision',stage_asset_id:x.asset_id||'none',stage_asset_version:Number(x.asset_version||1),review_key_source:[x.review_id,x.asset_id,Number(x.asset_version||1),decision,x.decision_modified_at].join('|')}}];
